newsitem.title: SPAIN: Iberia had 1.5 bln pta net profit in March 97. [CORRECTED 13:55 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Iberia had 1.5 bln pta net profit in March 97. [CORRECTED 13:55 GMT]

text.p: Spain's state-owned airline Iberia had net profit of 1.5 billion pesetas ($10.3 million) in March 1997 with an operating profit at three billion pesetas, an Iberia spokesman told Reuters on Monday.
(Corrects time period to March 1997 from Q1 1997)
"The net and the operating profit were respectively 500 and 1.500 million pesetas higher than initially forecast," the spokesman said.
He added that Iberia was satisfied with its business, especially in March when it recovered from losses of the first two months of the year.
The spokesman was commenting on press reports about Iberia's first two months losses, which stood at 2.86 billion pesetas.
"Our revenues per passenger rose 9.20 percent until March and our revenue per passenger/kilometers 14.94 percent," said.

While no comparison was available for the first quarter in 1996, Iberia reported a 1996 operating result for the first four months of 2.875 billion pesetas, the first positive four-month figure since 1989.
Iberia expects to close the current year with a net profit at 5.0 billion pesetas versus a 1996 profit of 3.5 billion pesetas.
